short.q: Why are the focus works not played in the exam?
short.model: Extracts are related to them in style, structure or genre; the aim is to learn skills and apply them to unfamiliar music.

short.q: How do you transpose a B flat clarinet part to concert pitch?
short.model: Move each written note down a major second and use the matching key signature.

short.q: Describe the structure of sonata form.
short.model: Exposition with first and second subjects in different keys, development exploring themes, recapitulation with both subjects in the tonic.

short.q: Name the four elements you would use to describe an extract.
short.model: Any four of: instruments, melody, harmony/tonality, rhythm/metre, texture, structure, dynamics/tempo, context.

short.q: Give one context point for Vivaldi's Spring.
short.model: It is a Baroque solo concerto, programme music based on a sonnet about spring.
